effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.).
